title: Privacy: an erase the cloud did not take, followed by a Disconnect before the retry, leaves the cloud copy as it was before the erase, with nothing left to send it
evidence: Privacy item; after S49. ios/engine/cloud.ts:297-298: a cloud erase whose upload fails keeps the erased record on the phone and leaves the retry to the background flush. The person is told the app sends it when the cloud answers (ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/EraseText.swift:66). A Disconnect is refused only while the erase runs (ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/CloudSync.swift:226), not while its upload waits. Its close tries one flush (cloud.ts:394), then copies the cloud down (:397); a failed flush is not reported. CloudSync.swift:240 then removes the pending marker, as launch cleanup does (:387), so nothing sends the erase later. The phone keeps the erase: its eraseEpoch is higher, and the merge gate drops the older rows (packages/health-core/src/merge.ts:780-786; record-session-erase.ts:129-132). The cloud file keeps the pre-erase record until this phone connects again and lifts its copy up (ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/CloudConnection.swift:211, firstConnect). Until then, anything that reads that cloud file reads the pre-erase record, and the words the person saw are no longer true. Needs a decision: refuse a Disconnect while an erase waits to go up, or say so in the Disconnect words. US-25 AC16, US-11 AC6
